sourceChecks.rationale: Public Codable model properties/initializers, enum raw spellings, action cases and View initializer match the contract. Only existing native SwiftUI/Foundation APIs are imported. Independent source-bound iOS14/macOS11 target typechecks both pass; this does not establish behavior on old operating-system runtimes.
Effective selection derives from the current model and excludes unavailable IDs/non-choosing modes; no local competing selection/fee state or caller-data mutation.

Whole native Button rows carry coherent labels and selected traits; Toggle uses supplied Binding and actual disabled/enabled modifiers. The panel establishes an accessibility containment boundary before its identifier. Target minimum layout declarations are 44pt or larger; runtime reachability/state are separately graded.
ScaledMetric, expanding multiline Text and no line limits/shrink-to-fit/fixed text heights. Narrow/large native runtime evidence remains independently graded per supplied case.
Intrinsic VStack and ForEach, no nested vertical ScrollView, fixed panel height or bounded lazy container.

Environment color scheme selects explicit light/dark palette; leading alignments and native HStack mirror with layout direction. Custom ButtonStyle preserves explicit disabled row/button colors. Runtime contrast/direction remains independently graded.
